decks.notes: The main objective of this deck is to control the game by countering spells and using removal to eliminate threats on the board. Utilizing cards like Counterspell, Swords to Plowshares, and Wrath of God, this deck aims to keep the opponent's creatures in check while drawing cards with Fact or Fiction and Impulse to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Standstill and Decree of Justice provide additional options for controlling the pace of the game, while the land base is optimized for consistent mana production and utility. Overall, this deck focuses on maintaining control and generating value to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent.

The focus of this deck is to quickly get Phyrexian Dreadnought onto the battlefield while using counter spells and disruptive cards to prevent the opponent from countering or removing it. The deck aims to use Stifle to counter any triggered abilities that would normally prevent Phyrexian Dreadnought's ability from resolving, allowing for a powerful combo to take place. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Vision Charm and Opt to help dig for important combo pieces, ensuring a consistent and fast win condition.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing the Oath of Druids card to bring out powerful creatures like Terravore while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland. The deck also includes removal spells like Pyroclasm and Naturalize to deal with threats, as well as mana acceleration from Mox Diamond. The land base is designed to support the deck's strategy, with Treetop Village and Mishra's Factory providing additional creatures for combat. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and control elements.

The focus of this deck is centered around assembling the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat on the battlefield. The deck includes ways to find and protect the combo pieces, with cards like Counterspell, Daze, and Foil for control and protection. The rest of the deck is made up of card draw and manipulation spells to help find the combo pieces quickly. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up the combo for a swift victory.

The main focus of this Enchantress combo deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Wild Growth and Exploration, while drawing cards with Argothian Enchantress and Enchantress's Presence. The deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Seal of Cleansing and Parallax Wave, while also setting up a win condition with Opalescence turning enchantments into creatures. The inclusion of cards like Solitary Confinement and Elephant Grass provides protection and stall tactics, allowing the deck to outvalue and overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells and removal spells, with a key strategy revolving around using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Akroma, Angel of Wrath. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation to help find key pieces, as well as some land destruction options to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent by controlling the board and overwhelming them with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By using efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, along with direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, the goal is to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. The inclusion of cards like Fireblast and Sulfuric Vortex provides additional reach and the ability to close out games even when the opponent stabilizes. Overall, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and end the game before the opponent can fully establish their board.

The deck focuses on assembling powerful creature combos using cards like Mesmeric Fiend, Volrath's Shapeshifter, and Phyrexian Devourer. It also utilizes the combo of Survival of the Fittest and Intuition to tutor for key pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy with Cabal Therapy. The deck includes a variety of powerful creatures like Akroma, Angel of Wrath and Phage the Untouchable to quickly close out games. Mana acceleration with Birds of Paradise and Wall of Roots helps ramp into big threats, while also fixing mana with lands like City of Brass and Reflecting Pool.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with Goblins, utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Piledriver to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Goblin Ringleader and Goblin Matron provide card advantage and search for key pieces, while cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Goblin Sharpshooter offer powerful board control options. With a combination of hard-hitting creatures and disruptive tactics like Gempalm Incinerator and Living Death, this deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent can establish a strong defense. The mana base is built to support consistent aggressive plays while also providing access to necessary colors for key spells.

The main focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly and efficiently, using cards like Cloud of Faeries, Sapphire Medallion, and Lotus Petal. The goal is to cast several cheap spells in a single turn to build up a storm count, allowing for a powerful Brain Freeze finisher to mill the opponent out. The deck utilizes draw spells like Frantic Search, Meditate, and Accumulated Knowledge to find combo pieces and sculpt the ideal hand. The strategy is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces and win the game with a massive storm count.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Replenish combo with cards like Academy Rector, Parallax Tide, and Opalescence to quickly overwhelm your opponent with powerful enchantments. The deck also includes various tools such as Swords to Plowshares, Frantic Search, and Seal of Cleansing to control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategy. The land base is designed to provide the necessary mana to cast the combo pieces efficiently. Overall, this deck aims to set up a game-winning combo as quickly as possible while maintaining control over the game.

The deck focuses on creating a lockout situation by playing Stasis and using cards like Black Vise and Forsaken City to control the opponent's resources while relying on countermagic and bounce spells to protect the lock. With a heavy emphasis on card draw and resource denial, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and create a situation where they are unable to effectively play cards or advance their board state.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing board control by aggressively casting disruptive spells like Armageddon and Gerrard's Verdict, while also utilizing land destruction with cards like Wasteland and Terravore to keep the opponent off balance. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures like Terravore and Tempting Wurm, supported by card advantage engines like Sylvan Library and Call of the Herd. The deck synergizes well with Mox Diamond to accelerate its game plan and utilizes a mix of white, black, and green spells to handle a variety of threats.

The main concept of this control deck is to ramp up quickly with mana dorks like Birds of Paradise and Wall of Roots, while using disruption spells like Cabal Therapy and Duress to control the opponent's hand. The deck also focuses on sacrificing creatures for value with cards like Natural Order and Recurring Nightmare, and ultimately closing out the game with powerful creatures like Multani, Maro-Sorcerer and Verdant Force. In addition, Pernicious Deed provides a versatile board wipe option to help maintain control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient creatures. By using abilities like protection and life gain, along with cards like Swords to Plowshares for removal and Armageddon for board control, the deck aims to maintain pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a focus on fast, aggressive gameplay, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on and maintain it throughout the game to secure victory.
